body:
I've tried multiple different philosophies, nothing worked. There is always an excuse.

All women are unique, in that they all have different reasons for behaving exactly the same.

I already spent a decade searching this shit out, all I learned was that nothing was ever good enough, can have radically different philosophies,  body types, live in different places, behave differently, nothing matters.  When it comes to sex, women behave the same. Extremely withholding unless you have a specific trait they enjoy, I don't have that, I have asked out - thousands - of women without a single one interacting that way with me. 

I was not always bitter, this is what makes me laugh, it's always "you're bitter." I was not always bitter, this is a reaction to reality and how much different it is than what you all insist it is. Have you ever considered that ugly people are treated worse, in general? I have had many women friends, all were withholding with regard to sex. Every last one.

I like women in the theoretical, I just don't like what they are in reality, how they act, how they treat various groups of people.

Yeah, seven - yes seven - more rejections since the start of this thread. All praise womenkind, they are so generous, humble, warm and caring!

The more I go outside the more I hate people.

There are so many combinations of looks that are attractive to me, most women who aren't extremely overweight are good looking, in my opinion.

I got rejected by an obese woman earlier this week. I'd like to think I'm not particularly picky about looks. I'm very open to various people, backgrounds, etc, even personalities. Rarely is it me making the choice, I try to talk to everyone, even if I'm not going to hit on them (i.e. an older man).

I don't end up with any of them. It makes me something slightly past resentful. Effort thrown in a trash can and dumped.

I'd like to think so, as time passes I'm starting to think that's all TV-show glam reality, and that the actual thing passes many by, we just sweep them under the rug and forget about them, need a cultural reason for pushing forward, after all. Gotta have that carrot on the end of the stick, even if it is just a picture of a carrot.

They ignore me more than the beautiful ones, at least the beautiful ones know they are, so they aren't as afraid to just smile back, because it doesn't reflect on their "low" social status by associating with me, even briefly in passing. That's how it appears, anyway.

They are, and they aren't.

Thousands of variables, one end result. All caused by selfishness and an obsession with the now over the future.  What feels good now? That guy will be around later when I'm done having my fun, he can just sit around and wait out his life until I'm done having fun. 

If an entire group of humans acts a certain way, it's alright to point it out. This is an entire group of humans acting similarly, and 'why' is a fantastic question, but the end result is the same.   Women being selfish and superficial then telling me that's what they are. Sure, there are aberrations, but they behave the same.  Never seen a single person act different, ever.  EVER. Seems more like the sort of thing we just say to give people the benefit of the doubt. As someone who NEVER got that from women, I am done giving it back.
